maddeler.e:
استقطعوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْطَعُوا (istaqṭaʕū) /is.taq.tˤa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اُسْتُقْطِعُوا (ustuqṭiʕū) /us.tuq.tˤi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# اِسْتَقْطِعُوا (istaqṭiʕū) /is.taq.tˤi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
